create_OpenAILM_generate: create an OpenAILM instance and generate a response from a prompt using the OpenAI API
create_OpenAILM_generate_batch: create an OpenAILM instance and generate responses for a batch of prompts at once
create_MultiTurnOpenAILM_generate: create a MultiTurnOpenAILM instance and generate a response using a multi-turn message history
create_MultiTurnOpenAILM_append_history: create a MultiTurnOpenAILM instance and append a new prompt to the conversation history
create_HFLM_generate: create an HFLM instance with vLLM and generate a response from a prompt using a local model
